history.summary: HISTORY FLAG: the old Shiva temple of the Baikunthapur Rajbari (Raikat) family, standing beside Rajbari Dighi (the big lake) and the recently built Rajbari Park in Rajbari Para, Adarpara, Jalpaiguri town. Visitor reviews consistently call it a century-old (or older) historical Shiva temple, but claimed ages swing between ~100 and 400–500 years with no documented date. The West Bengal government has developed a children's park adjacent to it. COORDINATE FLAG: map geocoder resolved only the Rajbari Palace complex (26.53903, 88.71776); the temple is adjacent at Rajbari Dighi — treat coordinates as approximate to the Rajbari area.

name: Rajbari Shib Mandir
town_description: Jalpaiguri is a district headquarters town in north West Bengal on the banks of the Teesta river. The temple is in Rajbari Para (Adarpara area), ~2 km from Kadamtala More, beside the large Rajbari Dighi lake.
